notes: The site authors no design tokens of its own — the only five custom properties on the page belong to Font Awesome. Colors below are exact rgb values from the computed-style census (cream rgb(249,228,194) = #f9e4c2, brick rgb(180,66,38) = #b44226, ink #000), corroborated against the screenshots. `muted` is not a real tier: the page has no grey text, so brick doubles as the de-emphasized/link color — recorded as such rather than inventing a grey. `focus-ring` is sampled from the focus-state probe, which reports the outline color drifting between #9f3c23 and #ab3f25 across elements (anti-aliased sampling of one color); treat as approximate. Type scale normalized to rem from the px census (12/14/14.4/16/19.2/24/32/44/56); the 11.01px / 12.8px / 37.33px entries are third-party accessibility-overlay chrome, dropped. Leading collapsed from 14 raw values to the two ratios the site actually uses (1.1 headings / 1.5 text) — every other raw lineHeight resolves to one of them. `shadow: []` is deliberate: the single reported box-shadow (grey 0 0 5px) belongs to the injected overlay widget, not the design. Radius likewise: 2px on two elements, 50% on the carousel dots, 0 everywhere else including all buttons. `craft.theme.supportsDark` is false and the `theme.dark` payload just re-reports the light palette, so `color.dark` is omitted. Motion durations come from the transition census, not from keyframes — the page defines zero @keyframes and loads zero animation libraries. `raw/gjelina.css` is a single ~50k-token minified line that could not be sliced with the tools available in this session, so token values are grounded in the computed-style profile + screenshots + scroll frames rather than in source declarations; the frames confirm the pinned header, the underlined headings, and the borderless sections independently.
